documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 results, recording Q2 revenue from operations of INR 818.7 crores with a 54.8% Y-o-Y growth and sales volume of 577 kgs. The company is setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary to expand into silver, platinum, lab-grown diamonds, and lightweight jewellery via online B2C and B2B channels. Additionally, its newly introduced bridal jewellery segment has grown to account for approximately 10% of overall manufacturing operations. Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited reported H1 FY27 revenue from operations of ₹1,367.15 crore, up 58.7% YoY, while PAT grew 43.1% YoY to ₹73.47 crore. The company operationalized its Kandivali facility, expanding total manufacturing capacity from 2,500 kg to 4,000 kg with an investment of approximately ₹15 crore funded through internal accruals.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting to scale its corporate business share from 51% to 65%.
guidance.quote: By doing so, We are targeting to scale our corporate business share from 51% to 65% in the coming days.

guidance.claim: Management expects increasing corporate client share to improve its business rolling cycle by at least 1.5 times.
guidance.quote: This will improve our business rolling cycle by at least 1.5 times.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the bridal jewelry segment could potentially reach a level comparable to its core business in two to two-and-a-half years.
guidance.quote: in fact, within two to two-and-a-half years, it could potentially reach a level comparable to our core business.

guidance.claim: Management expects production from the expanded capacity to ramp up in the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: Commercial production from the current capacity resumed from 23rd February 2026. The production is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the demand environment remains encouraging due to the ongoing festive and wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming to the industry, the demand environment remains encouraging, particularly with the festive and wedding season underway.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for lightweight jewelry, contemporary design, and affordable products continues to create new opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand for the lightweight jewellery, contemporary design, and affordable products continues to create opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the company currently has a massive volume of orders.
demand_outlook.quote: Today we have a massive volume of orders.

demand_outlook.claim: H1 FY27 revenue grew by 58.7% YoY to Rs 1,367.15 crore from Rs 861.41 crore in H1 FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue grew 58.7% YoY to ₹1,367.15 crore in H1 FY27 from ₹861.41 crore in H1 FY26.

demand_outlook.claim: The company uses outsourced production alongside in-house capacity to satisfy growing demand.
demand_outlook.quote: To meet growing demand, the company complements its in-house capacity with outsourced production.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for the company's products will be driven by the expansion plans of its corporate clientele.
demand_outlook.quote: The expansion plans of our corporate clientele will drive additional demand for our products

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary to expand across the broader jewelry value chain.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term expansion strategy, we are in the process of setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary to expand our presence across the broader jewellery value chain.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed subsidiary will mandate manufacturing, designing, trading, and distribution across gold, silver, diamond, and semi-precious stones.
capex_expansion.quote: The proposed subsidiary will have a diversified business mandate covering the manufacturing, designing, trading, and distribution of jewellery and accessories across categories, such as gold, silver, diamond, precious and semi-precious stones, and other materials.

capex_expansion.claim: The company intends to expand its manufacturing capacity to strengthen its market position.
capex_expansion.quote: To further strengthen this position, we intend to expand our manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested approximately Rs 15 crore through internal accruals to expand capacity, upgrade machinery, and improve operational efficiency.
capex_expansion.quote: Approx. ₹15 crore invested via internal accruals to expand capacity, upgrade machinery, improve efficiency, and meet growing demand.

capex_expansion.claim: Branch offices were opened in Delhi and Pune by the company.
capex_expansion.quote: Opened branch offices in Delhi and Pune

margins_costs.claim: Q2 EBITDA stood at INR 54.9 crores with EBITDA margin at 6.7%, representing a 50 bps Y-o-Y increase.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR54.9 crores, a 68.7% growth Y-0-Y, while EBITDA margin stood at 6.7%, a growth of 50 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that an increase in gold prices improves the company's profitability.
margins_costs.quote: If gold prices increase, our profitability actually improves.

margins_costs.claim: The company increased production capacity from 2.5 to 4 tonnes, which required hiring additional designers and staff.
margins_costs.quote: Sir, as I mentioned, we have already increased our capacity from 2.5 to 4 tonnes; consequently, we will need to increase our headcount.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 PAT increased by 43.1% YoY to Rs 73.47 crore, recording a PAT margin of 5.37%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT grew 43.1% YoY to ₹73.47 crore, with a PAT margin of 5.37%.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume for Q2 reached 577 kgs, representing a 10% Y-o-Y increase.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume for the quarter stood at 577 kgs, up by 10% Y-0-Y.

orders_capacity.claim: Bridal jewelry accounts for approximately 10% of total manufacturing volume.
orders_capacity.quote: So, within our entire manufacturing operations, the bridal jewellery segment accounts for approximately 10%.

orders_capacity.claim: Following the addition of new capacity in February 2026, the full-year blended capacity reached 2,625 kgs with an actual utilization rate of 87%.
orders_capacity.quote: The new capacity was added in February 2026. Blended capacity for full year is 2625 kgs. Hence, actual capacity utilization is 87%.

orders_capacity.claim: New production capacity was added by the company in February 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: The new capacity was added in February 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that cash flow management is its top priority.
capital_allocation.quote: Limited cash flow management is our top priority today.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a minimum of 30% plus hedged inventory.
capital_allocation.quote: Right now we keep at least 30% plus hedged inventory.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash outflow improved to -Rs 77.91 crore in H1 FY27 from -Rs 412.11 crore in H1 FY26 due to reduced working capital outflow.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash outflow from operating activities improved to -₹77.91 crore from -₹412.11 crore, supported by lower working capital outflow.

capital_allocation.claim: Growth funds were made available to the company through its listing.
capital_allocation.quote: Listing of the company enabled growth funds

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility and uncertainty in gold prices have made consumers more cautious regarding spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: We are also seeing growing preferences for organized and branded jewellery, while volatility and uncertainty in gold price have made consumers more cautious about their spending.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations remain working capital intensive, requiring adequate funds to support geographic expansion and portfolio diversification.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our operations are working capital intensive, requiring adequate liquidity and funds to support business expansion and diversification across multiple locations

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to increase its corporate client share from 51% to 65%.
management_commitments.quote: By doing so, We are targeting to scale our corporate business share from 51% to 65% in the coming days.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to execute the launch of the new subsidiary within two to three months.
management_commitments.quote: given that the approval is already in place, I expect us to exccute everything within two to three months.

management_commitments.claim: The company anticipates the bridal segment could reach a scale comparable to its core business in two to two-and-a-half years.
management_commitments.quote: in fact, within two to two-and-a-half years, it could potentially reach a level comparable to our core business.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production resumed on February 23, 2026, with production expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.
management_commitments.quote: Commercial production from the current capacity resumed from 23rd February 2026. The production is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
